The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 151fe6144a42154d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 8-9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X(w) ∈ Z and suppose that nonnegative short integers m(w) and λ(w) are computable in polynomial time, with |X(w)| ≤ 2m(w). Define Z = max(16, m, λ), Y = 2Z4 . (2.3) 8 If X(w) mod p, represented in {0, . . . , p − 1}, is uniformly computable in Fa for primes λ < p ≤ Y , then sgn X(w) is in Fmax(a,5)+3.
